## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`) on the D = 0 line: e-side n = +3.2×10¹² (run 6, 0 → 10 T, 10 mT), h-side n = −1.2×10¹² (run 7, 10 → 0.3 T, 20 mT)

Both at base T (1.17–1.29 K), V_si = 0, sr1 50 µV (5 kΩ FS), gates at the run-5-calibrated spots. Raw first (R(B), R(1/B)), then the detrended 1/B traces, the FFTs against the full-density Luttinger frequency F_L = |n|h/4e, the `sdh_onset` tone tables, and the resistance minima converted to total filling factor ν = nh/eB under the run-5 scale (and under a +8.7 % scale, the alternative that would make the run-6 zeros ν = 24/20).

"""Runs 6-7 (sdh-spot-check): raw R(B), detrended 1/B, FFT vs F_L, sdh_onset tones, minima -> filling factors."""
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
from scipy.signal import argrelmin

spots = {6: +3.2, 7: -1.2}   # 1e12 cm^-2 (run-5 calibration, scale = geometry prior)
traces = {}
for rid, n12 in spots.items():
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = np.abs((r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I); T = r.col("T_sample")
    o = np.argsort(B); traces[rid] = (B[o], R[o], I[o], T[o], n12)
    print(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, {len(B)} pts, B {B.min():.2f}..{B.max():.2f} T (median step {np.median(np.abs(np.diff(B)))*1e3:.0f} mT), "
          f"R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm (fs max {R.max()/5000:.2f}), I_drain {I.min()*1e9:.2f}..{I.max()*1e9:.2f} nA, T {T.min():.3f}..{T.max():.3f} K, interrupted {r.interrupted}")

# (1) raw
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 7.5))
for k, rid in enumerate(spots):
    B, R, I, T, n12 = traces[rid]
    ax[k, 0].plot(B, R, lw=0.8); ax[k, 0].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[k, 0].set_ylabel("|Rxx| B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
    ax[k, 0].set_title(f"run {rid} raw: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0, T = {T.mean():.2f} K")
    m = B > 1; ax[k, 1].plot(1 / B[m], R[m], lw=0.8); ax[k, 1].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[k, 1].set_ylabel("|Rxx| (Ohm)"); ax[k, 1].set_title(f"run {rid} raw vs 1/B (B > 1 T)")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# (2) analysis: detrended 1/B trace + FFT vs F_L, sdh_onset tone table, minima -> nu
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 7.5))
for k, rid in enumerate(spots):
    B, R, I, T, n12 = traces[rid]
    FL = luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16)
    m = B >= 1.0; bg = np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5), B[m])
    ax[k, 0].plot(1 / B[m], R[m] - bg, lw=0.7); ax[k, 0].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[k, 0].set_ylabel("dR (Ohm)"); ax[k, 0].set_title(f"run {rid} detrended (poly5 in B), B > 1 T")
    for lo in (1.0, 2.0, 4.0):
        mm = (B >= lo) & (B <= 10.0)
        f, sp = sdh_fft(R[mm][:, None], B[mm], nfft=2048, bg_degree=5, log=False)
        ax[k, 1].plot(f, sp[0] / sp[0][f > 2].max(), label=f"{lo:.0f}-10 T (1/B res {1/(1/lo-0.1):.1f} T)", alpha=0.8)
    ax[k, 1].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", lw=0.8, label=f"F_L(4-fold, n={n12:+.1f}) = {FL:.1f} T"); ax[k, 1].axvline(FL / 2, color="gray", ls=":", lw=0.8)
    ax[k, 1].set_xlim(0, 60); ax[k, 1].set_xlabel("SdH frequency (T)"); ax[k, 1].set_ylabel("norm. FFT amp"); ax[k, 1].legend(fontsize=7); ax[k, 1].set_title(f"run {rid} FFT windows")
    print(f"\n--- run {rid}: F_L = {FL:.1f} T (F_L/2 = {FL/2:.1f}); n h/e = {abs(n12)*41.357:.1f} T ---")
    try:
        print(sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=0.5, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9).summary())
    except Exception as e:
        print("sdh_onset:", type(e).__name__, e)
    Rs = gaussian_filter1d(R, 2 if rid == 6 else 1.5); mm = B > (2.5 if rid == 6 else 1.0)
    idx = argrelmin(Rs[mm], order=15 if rid == 6 else 8)[0]
    nhe = abs(n12) * 41.357
    print("minima:  " + "  ".join(f"{B[mm][i]:.2f}T({Rs[mm][i]:.0f}Ω) ν={nhe/B[mm][i]:.1f}|{1.087*nhe/B[mm][i]:.1f}" for i in idx))
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

**Read (runs 6–7):** Both spots oscillate from ≈ 1 T (onset tool: lowest tones censored at the 0.5 T record edge), well inside the fs 0.12 headroom, no leakage (TG flyback-free here; the ±110 pA "LEAK" flags are the 2400's offset scatter), T stable within 0.13 K. **Run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹²):** quantum-Hall-like zeros (R ≤ 7 Ω) at 5.92 and 7.16 T and near-zeros at 2.70, 3.24, 3.72, 4.28 T, then a non-oscillatory rise to 530 Ω at 8.5 T falling to 330 Ω at 10 T. The zeros are **not one 1/B-periodic ladder** (Δ(1/B) between successive minima 0.061, 0.040, 0.035, 0.064, 0.029 T⁻¹) — two ladders, or one ladder with a lifted degeneracy. Under the run-5 scale the two deep zeros sit at total ν ≈ 22.4 / 18.5 (a 4k+2 sequence, Dirac-like offset — the ABCB reading); an 8.7 % larger n puts them at ν = 24 / 20 (a 4k sequence — the ABAB/ABCA reading). The two are indistinguishable from a single cut because the absolute density scale is the geometry prior (c_tg from 9.5 nm hBN), unverified. The FFTs are **not tone spectra**: the 7.5–8 T jump survives the poly-5 detrend and produces combs at the window's 1/B resolution (2.5 T for 2–10 T, 6.7 T for 4–10 T); the tool's 7.2 T "tone" and its "harmonics" are that jump. **Run 7 (n = −1.2×10¹²):** deep minima at 1.68 T (12 Ω) and 2.04 T (14 Ω) with fast oscillations below 2 T and slow, large ones above (maxima 335 Ω at 2.45 T, 300 Ω at 4 T); minima 2.74, 3.38, 4.14, 4.92, 6.00, 6.94, 8.34 T → ν ≈ 18, 15, 12, 10, 8.3, 7.2, 6.0 under the run-5 scale — again not a single ladder; this close to the CNP a semimetal's second (heavier, opposite-sign) pocket is expected to interleave. Neither cut supports a single-band ABCA picture (a single 4-fold ladder at F = F_L with no interleaving) — consistent with the small, saturating D gap of run 5 — but the ABAB vs ABCB split hangs on absolute ν, which a fan gives from LL-line slopes (dn/dB = νe/h) independent of the calibration scale. That is plan step 4.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan on the D = 0 line (`landau-fan`), n −1.28 → +3.26×10¹² fast × B 1 → 10 T slow

> **05:28** · landau-fan D=0 (plan step 4): n -1.28..+3.26e12 fast, 100 pts co-swept Vtg -0.30..+1.00 / Vbg -0.49..+1.19 V on the run-5 D=0 line; B slow 1->10 T, 100 mT, 91 rows; sr1 100 uV (10 kOhm FS), fast\_delay 1 s, slow\_delay 4 s, 1 nA leak guard; base T, Vsi 0; ends at 10 T, gates parked 0 · **ETA ~10:08** (≈4h40m)

**Why now (plan step 4; picks up after the handoff with the rig at 0 T, gates 0).** The two spot checks (runs 6, 7, ana) show quantum-Hall zeros from ~3 T but **no single 1/B-periodic ladder**, and their filling factors cannot be assigned from a fixed-n cut: run 6's zeros at 5.92 / 7.16 T are ν = 22 / 18 (a 4k+2, Dirac-like sequence → ABCB reading) on the run-5 scale, or ν = 24 / 20 (a 4k sequence → ABAB/ABCA reading) if the geometry-prior density scale is 8.7 % low. A fan breaks that degeneracy independent of the calibration: each Landau-level line has slope dn/dB = νe/h, which gives ν absolutely *and* the lever arm the run-5 calibration lacks. It then reads the stacking directly — **ABAB**: two interpenetrating 4-fold ladders (crossings), first CNP gaps at ν = ±8/±4; **ABCA**: one ladder, no crossings, CNP column insulating at high B; **ABCB**: a 4(N+½) Dirac ladder interleaved with a 4k ladder, first CNP gap at ν = ±6. Region B (ridge B, run 5) will appear as shadow lines offset +0.43×10¹² — a control, not a band.

**Design.** Fast axis: the run-5-calibrated D = 0 line, co-swept (V_tg, V_bg) via `multimegasweep`, from the hole edge n = −1.28 to the electron edge +3.26×10¹² — both ends set by the TG limit (V_tg −0.30 → +1.00 V, V_bg −0.49 → +1.19 V), 100 points (Δn 0.046×10¹² = 13 mV TG steps; the ν = 4 lines are 4 columns apart at 2 T, 21 at 10 T). Slow axis: B 1 → 10 T in 100 mT (91 rows), ascending from where the magnet sits; nothing is resolvable below ~1 T at T_e ≈ 8 K (run 6). Fixed sr1 100 µV (10 kΩ FS; run-5 sizing rule — only a > 10.9 kΩ CNP column at high B could rail, and that is not the column the read needs). Lock-in τ 0.3 s / 24 dB: the 1 s fast dwell (run-5 calibrated 1.10 s/pt) carries a ≈ 4τ = 1.2 s group delay, i.e. a uniform ≈ 1-column lag along n in every row (same direction each row → a constant, correctable offset). 1 nA leak guard on both Keithleys interrupts the sweep. **Coverage trade:** the hole side reaches only −1.28×10¹² (the ν = −8 line leaves the window at 6.6 T, ν = −4 stays in); full ±3×10¹² symmetry is outside the committed box. Ends at **10 T with the gates parked at 0** — the finite-D follow-up (plan 5a) rides the magnet down.

**Price.** From run 5 (1.10 s/pt incl. reads): 100 pts + flyback (1.3 V at 5 mV ≈ 1.6 s + BG) + 4 s slow_delay + 100 mT ramp (44 s + 3 s settle) ≈ 164 s/row × 91 rows + 7 min to 1 T ≈ 4 h 17 m; realistic +8 % → **≈ 4 h 40 m**. **Checkpoints (E1):** first row (rail, leak, flat or dead channel, T); then ≈ 3 T, 5 T, 7 T — partial `fan_grids` re-form, look for LL lines converging on the CNP and count ladders; abort on a rail across many columns, a leak trip, T_sample > 1.5 K, or no LL structure by 5 T.

# === Landau fan on the D = 0 line (`landau-fan`): n fast [-1.28, +3.26]e12 (100 pts) x B slow 1 -> 10 T (100 mT, 91 rows) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, absolute scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left 0 T), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- fast axis: the D = 0 line (region-A calibration), hole edge -> electron edge, both ends TG-limited ---
N_FAST = 100
_ns = np.linspace(-2, 4, 6001); _Vt, _Vb = calc_gate_voltages(_ns, 0.0, **CAL)
_ok = (_Vt >= TG_MIN) & (_Vt <= TG_MAX) & (_Vb >= BG_MIN) & (_Vb <= BG_MAX)
n_vec = np.linspace(_ns[_ok].min() + 0.005, _ns[_ok].max() - 0.005, N_FAST)          # 1e12 cm^-2
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, 0.0, **CAL)
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, "fast line leaves the validator box"
assert len(Vtg_vec) == len(Vbg_vec) == N_FAST
_nchk, _Dchk = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, **CAL)
assert np.allclose(_nchk, n_vec) and np.abs(_Dchk).max() < 1e-6
print(f"fast line: n {n_vec[0]:+.3f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.3f} e12 ({N_FAST} pts, dn {n_vec[1]-n_vec[0]:.4f}e12); "
      f"Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V ({(Vtg_vec[1]-Vtg_vec[0])*1e3:.1f} mV), Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V ({(Vbg_vec[1]-Vbg_vec[0])*1e3:.1f} mV)")

# --- slow axis: B 1 -> 10 T, 100 mT, ascending (magnet sits at 0; ends at the cap so the next step rides down) ---
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.1), 4)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 4.0     # 1 s/pt (run-5 calibrated 1.10 s/pt incl. reads); 4 s after the 1.3 V flyback (> 10 tau)
I_TRIP = 1e-9

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA. LL minima (tens of Ohm) sit at 0.2-0.5 % of FS,
# readable per run 5; only a CNP column > 10.9 kOhm at high B would rail, and that column is not what the read needs.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} rows, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS); "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D=0: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 fast ({N_FAST} pts, co-swept Vtg/Vbg on the run-5 D=0 line), "
                  f"B 1->10 T slow 100 mT ({len(B_vec)} rows), sr1 100 uV, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, base T, Vsi 0")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 line (run-5 cal: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm); '
              f'fast n {n_vec[0]:+.3f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.3f} e12 cm^-2, {N_FAST} pts (Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.3f}..{Vtg_vec[-1]:+.3f}, Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.3f}..{Vbg_vec[-1]:+.3f} V); '
              f'slow B 1 -> 10 T, 100 mT, {len(B_vec)} rows; T = base; Vsi = 0; sr1 100 uV; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)    # gates parked; the field stays where the sweep left it (10 T on completion)
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")

B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.arange(10.0, 0.2999, -0.02), 4))[::-1]   # 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 250-300 Ohm near the CNP side; MR + SdH maxima at 10 T size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check hole: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'hole side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-B 20 mT (ride-down); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
